capabilities: color selected text with theme CSS variables from a right-click submenu
highlight text with matching transparent background colors
preview colors as circles in the context menu
remove color styling with an eraser option
apply colors through commands assignable to hotkeys
extras: The colored text is wrapped in spans using Obsidian CSS variables (e.g. var(--color-red)), so colors follow the active theme; manual installation steps are documented alongside community-plugin install.
problem: Coloring text in Obsidian normally means hardcoding hex values or writing raw HTML span tags, which breaks when you switch themes or between light and dark mode.
summary: Text coloring plugin that wraps selected text in theme-based CSS variables for color and highlight, applied via right-click menu or commands.
